'''Noy Torvald''' lives in [[Mardecin]] in Amadicia.

== Activities ==
He does odd jobs for widow [[Teran]]. He has an old coach which he sells to [[Thom Merrilin]] when he with [[Juilin]], [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] need better transportation.{{ref/book|5|10}}
